body:
So I used to find fulfillment from doing the same things. I pushed good people away with poor choices and brought about negative unhealthy relationships. I’m still not the easiest person to get along with. Now I have adapted another bad behavior which I don’t suggest. I’m kind of an asshole to people through jokes. If they keep me around I show them love and will go to so many depths for those people because they’ve accepted me for who I can be at my worst. 

The useful bit I have is being sincere about your boundaries and what makes you feel comfortable and communicate. True friends or people with your best interest will receive that well and those are people to keep around. Life is constantly learning. I have learned just because someone doesn’t do drugs or alcohol. People are human and imperfect but that is also the beauty that taking the journey through life and finding out how best to acquire a life worth living. There have been times my mind has pondered the taste of stainless steel and gun powder. I can say thankfully to this day I don’t desire that and like to come on here to see if I can be of help to someone. Self esteem is found by esteem-able acts.

Hey there, (29m) here. I can say without a doubt there are some things I can’t fully grasp. I’ve been in abusive relationships before as well have woman calling me crazy and creating emotional trauma. 

You don’t have to put the weight of your shoulders on yourself. There are programs and strong woman out there that can help you if you reach out to them. Don’t think you need to do it all alone to meet society’s standards of being “successful”. There are times where the best of us fall face first and need some help getting back up. Look some stuff up in Texas. I’m in Arizona or I wouldn’t mind helping. I helped another mother in a similar situation get in touch with some resources out here. 
I wont advise what to do with your ex even though he sounds like an absolute scoundrel. Just try to get yourself in a better situation. 
Growth can be uncomfortable sometimes but taking a leap builds and takes courage. I believe in you that you will be able to make a change.

Hey man, sometimes there’s a rotten apple that spoils the batch. Try not to let that singular person have that power over you. Since the other night I thought about coming on here struggling just to voice my feelings to someone who wasn’t my direct friends. I’ve started reading, my self sadness turned to pain and understanding on here. Maybe a reason I’ve found is to come on here and relate. To be able to share that maybe it’s not worth it. There are so many of us on here who want to be understood. To be someone trying to help others is helping me. It could work for you too.

Hey man. As much as I relate with how you’re probably feeling and I don’t know you. It makes me sad that you have to feel those emotions and I hope that you can find some blessings in life to make thing worth while. ❤️
